system.description: Look at your target and perform a Static Mental Challenge (difficulty equal to the target's Mental Traits). If you succeed, ask one question: what manner of creature the target is, whether affected by magic, whether they committed diablerie recently, their current emotional state, or whether their last utterance was a lie; the target must answer truthfully. Expending a Mental Trait and winning or tying a Mental Challenge lets you see nearby ghosts as pale, indistinct auras.
